text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Half the contestants have already dropped 
out, and the battle is reaching its 
climax! 
The ones remaining are Mejiro McQueen, 
Gold Ship...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! —And Maruzensky, along with 
Sakura Chiyono O. 
Who will seize victory? Could it truly be 
Golshi-chan?!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, don't just grab the—! 
That went right into the microphone!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For real? So the whole island can hear me? 
HEEEEEY! Can you guys hear me out 
theeeere?!

text_block_list.name: Island Announcement
text_block_list.text:
“I'm bored of picking seaweed, so I'm 
coming to hunt you down! 
I'm gonna swim upriver with the salmon, 
just you waaaait!!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...That voice! She's at the main stage, 
isn't she?! 
The nerve of her! I shall march over there 
and strike her down this insta...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahem...! Goodness, she is carrying on 
quite excessively. 
She is causing trouble for the MC as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(I shall not lose my composure like that. 
As an umamusume of the Mejiro family, I 
will claim victory with grace...)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The grass around here looks a teeny bit 
trodden on... 
Hmm~? Oh... I knew it♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're there, aren't you? 
Come on out, Chiyo-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Maruzen-san... 
But how did you know it was me?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Your stride length, of course♪ Golshi-chan 
has longer legs, 
and your stride is different from 
McQueen-chan's too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This neat, uniform stride is proof of your 
devoted training. 
It's the running form of the Chiyo-chan I 
know so well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You really do pay close attention to 
everything, don't you? 
You truly are an amazing person. ...Which 
is why...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I'm going to defeat you!! 
Maruzen-san! Prepare yourselfーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ーーGh!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
(She's fast! And she's reading my 
movements before she shoots...?!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Looks like... this won't be a walk in the 
park after all! 
ーーTake this!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Whoa! ...That won't hit me! 
I practiced dodging with Yaeno-san, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Now it's my turn! Taaahhhーー!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Kyah! That was close! 
Haa, haa...! Kh...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
(She's pushing me back...? There's no 
opening anywhere...!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You truly never let me get bored for even 
a second, do you? 
All right then, let me show you... 
Haaahhhーー!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What?! She shifted into an even higher 
gear...! 
She's charging straight at me?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(I won't let her! I'm going to win this! 
Draw her in until the very last second... 
RIGHT NOWーー!!)

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Maruzen
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAHHHーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Island Announcement
text_block_list.text:
“ーーThe winner is... Sakura Chiyono O!! 
A direct hit with everything she had! What 
a magnificent shotーー!”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Out of ammo, huh... Aww, I really thought 
I had you. 
Hehe, what a shame... Heheheh...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*, *pant*...! 
D-Did I... win? Y-Yay...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A total defeat for me. I never thought I'd 
get so fired up... 
Huh! Chiyo-chan, behind you!!
Oryaaaaーーh!!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“ーーSakura Chiyono O tries to run! What a 
brutal back-to-back battle! 
Ohhh, no! She has finally fallen to Gold 
Ship's fierce assaultーー!”

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“And with that, only two remain: Gold Ship 
and Mejiro McQueen! 
Now, how do you see this unfolding, our 
guest commentator, Nakayama-san?”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Commentator? 
Hey, hey, I was just killing time by 
sharing my thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever... It's a natural outcome, 
if you think about it. 
Both Golshi and McQueen are head and 
shoulders above the rest in raw physical 
ability.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking pure ability, McQueen's 
the safe bet. 
She could easily turn this into a battle 
of wits or an endurance match... But.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You never know what crazy stunt Golshi's 
gonna pull until the very end. 
Her strength is terrifyingly erratic.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's what's gonna decide this match. 
Get sucked into her pace and misjudge the 
critical moment, and you're done for...!

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“I see...! Gold Ship's condition will 
certainly be something to watch. 
How Mejiro McQueen chooses to deal with it 
is going to be quite a spectacle!”

text_block_list.name: Island Announcement
text_block_list.text:
“Now, this year's champion will finally be 
decided. 
Who will emerge victoriousーー?!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, you managed to survive to the end 
after all. 
It would have been terribly anti-climactic 
otherwise...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, the final victor will be me! 
Def-i-nite-ly me! 
As promised, you will behave yourself, so 
prepare yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! That will not do. 
I mustn't let my personal grudge show too 
much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(The other students are watching, so I 
must conduct myself properly. 
The wager is strictly a personal matter... 
I mustn't get overly heated.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose I shall wait for her at the 
main stage. 
That should make the event all the more 
exciting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As an umamusume of the Mejiro family, 
I have only to quietly claim my victory.
